summary: An armed raid on the project complex interrupts [[character:bob-replicant]]'s training. He directs a swarm of [[technology:roamers]] to aid security, helping force the attackers to surrender; three people die and several are injured. He later learns that a tactical nuclear weapon is supposedly held as a last safeguard against him escaping. Secretly mapping the complex through an unaccounted-for ROAMer, he finds the computer room and discovers five candidate cubes: his and [[character:kenneth-martins]]'s are active, while three others are powered down, although Bob's individual label remains unrevealed.

introducing.name: Kenneth Martins
introducing.description: One of the five replicant candidates for the project [[character:bob-replicant]] is training for. During a covert [[technology:roamers|roamer]] search, Bob finds Kenneth's name on a candidate cube in an isolated computer room and decides not to switch him off or sabotage him.
introducing.current_state: Represented by one of the two candidate cubes that remain powered on.

updates.description: Remote observation and manipulation devices directed through [[technology:guppi-interface|GUPPI]]. They come in varied sizes, can coordinate across scales, and need minimal supervision once their tasks, dependencies, and interruption conditions are defined. Without active intervention, they can work up to ten times faster. They can travel along floors, walls, and ceilings, and carry video cameras for remote observation.
